column3: As to the types of afflictions, according to Sutras, there are eighty four thousandafflictions. To make it simple, there are mainly ten:(1) greed, greed for and possession of things(2) hatred, giving arise to dislike, hatred, anger, jealousy etc. feelings to thecircumstances one does not like.(3) Stupidity, ignorant of the facts of life in the universe, which leads to erroneousideas, language and actions(4) arrogance, attaching to one's advantages and look down upon others(5) doubt toward the truths(6) holding on to the body of five aggregates as self(7) holding this body as either permanent or being cut off and perished(8) wrong views, denying cause and effect(9) regarding the view of holding the body of five aggregates as self, the view ofholding this body as either permanent or cut off and perished and wrong views astruths(10) following some erroneous disciplines and believing them as ways of liberation.These ten afflictions are called root afflictions in Buddhism. They are most importantones among all afflictions.关于烦恼的种类，经中说有八万四千烦恼。简单归纳，主要有十种，分别是贪、嗔、痴、慢、疑、身见、边见、邪见、见取见、戒禁取见。贪，是对事物的贪求和占有之心。嗔，是对不喜欢的境界生起仇怨、苦恼、损害等情绪。痴，是对宇宙人生真相的无知，从而引发错误的观念与言行。慢，是执着自身长处而轻视他人。疑，是因缺乏智慧而对真理产生怀疑。身见，是执五蕴身为我。边见，是执此身为永恒或断灭的两种片面认识。邪见，是否认因果规律，否定凡圣之别。见取见，是将身见、边见、邪见等执为真理。戒禁取见，是遵守一些错误戒律，以为能由此解脱。在佛教中，将这十种烦恼称为根本烦恼，是其他烦恼生起的基础。

column8: Dependent origination, conditioned genesis, etc. (prati^tya-samutpa^da). Also written in Chinese as yuansheng 缘生 and yinyuansheng 因缘生. The condition of relationship to something else resulting in arising or production. To be due to, in the sense of ...due to A, B arises. In the meaning of 'causal production,' all phenomena are given rise to due to the mutual relationships of countless causes (hetu: 因) and conditions (pratyaya: 缘) and are not independently existent. If all causes and conditions did not exist, no results or 'fruits' (phala: 果) could come into existence. This is a basic Buddhist teaching common to all schools of thought--that all production is the result of mutually dependent existence. Theoretically this shows the impossibility of a singular, eternal or truly substantial existence. In terms of practice, the aim is, in making this cause and effect relationship clear, to release one from the phenomenal world (of suffering) by removing these causes and conditions.

column3: 我们要用缘起的智慧来观照人生，充分地认识到，财富、地位、家庭、事业、名誉及世间的一切，甚至包括我们的色身，都是无常变幻的。We need to observe life with the wisdom of dependent origination, to clearly understand that wealth, social status, family, career, reputation and all worldly possessions including our physical body, are impermanent and changing.

如果我们认识到这一点，就能减少对世间万物的执着，让我们的心从物欲中慢慢解脱出来，再也不为这些东西左右，再也不为它们要死要活，从而保有心态的超然，保有人格的独立。With that recognized, our clinging to the worldly possessions would be lessened, and our mind would be liberated gradually from material desires, with no more craving or desperation for them, keeping a detached mindset and independent individuality.
我们也要用缘起的智慧来观照心念。We also need to observe our mind with the wisdom of dependent origination.
我们也要用缘起的智慧来观照心念。We also need to observe our mind with the wisdom of dependent origination.

如果没有智慧的观照，我们就会缺乏辨别真相的能力，就不能透过现象看到事物的本质，把这些原本非我的东西，当成是我，造成无尽的人生烦恼和痛苦。Without wise observation, we will not be able to tell the truth, see the essence through phenomena, instead, we could mistake all that is not the self for the self, which causes endless sufferings and pains.
我们只有通达了无我真理，才能消除由此而来的一切祸患。Only through realizing the truth of non-self (anatta) can we root out all tragedies caused by self-attachment.
column8: The lack of existence of an inherent self, soul, or ego, usually translated into English as "no-self" (Skt. ana^tman, Pali anatta^, Tib. bdag me byun%). This is one of the most important philosophical concepts in all of Buddhism, and is recorded as having been one of the primary realizations attained by S/a^kyamuni in his enlightenment experience.

column3: 如果我们通达无我的真理，就能更正确地认识自己生命。With the truth of non-self (anatta) comprehended, our life will be correctly understood.
如果我们通达无我的真理，才有可能开发出本自具足的智慧，寻找到本自具足的佛性。With the truth of non-self (anatta) comprehended, we can develop the innate wisdom and find the Buddha-nature.
如果我们通达无我的真理，才有可能开发出本自具足的智慧，寻找到本自具足的佛性。With the truth of non-self (anatta) comprehended, we can develop the innate wisdom and find the Buddha-nature.
column8: The buddha-nature. The possession by sentient beings of the innate buddha-mind, which is, prior to the full attainment of buddhahood, not fully actualized. The belief in this concept was not universally accepted in Indian Buddhism, but did become a cornerstone of East Asian Buddhist soteriological thought in terms of the essence-function 体用 paradigm, as explained in texts such as the Buddha-nature Treatise 佛性论.　A synonym for tatha^gatagarbha 如来藏.

column3: Perhaps the Buddha refrained from saying anything critical of him because he could see Svasti's wholehearted efforts to be master of his six senses, even if his mastery was far from complete.缚悉底在修行道上，仍 有一大段的路要走，但他对降伏六根的精勤和意 志，则可能就是佛陀再没有对他多作批评的原因。

column2: as if he himself were the one at fault
column3: Whenever Svasti saw another bhikkhu or bhikkhuni being corrected, he took it to heart as if he himself were the one at fault.每当有其他的比丘或比丘尼被纠正的时候，缚悉底都会以他自己犯错的心情去听受训导。
This provided him with many opportunities ot deepen his practice.他这样 的学习态度，使他在修行上有很多的进益。
He especially took to heart any correction and guidance the Buddha gave to Rahula.他尤 其留意佛陀对罗睺罗的训示。
Rahula continued to make great strides in his practice, and that benefited Savasti's practice as well.罗睺罗在修行上已 有很大的时展，这也间接令缚悉底在修行上获益 不浅。
He said that because he had tasted true peace, joy, and freedom, he had no more desire of the life of the word.他透露自己已对欲世 的生活全无留恋，因为他已尝到真正的平和、喜 悦和自由。
Rahula cautioned him," While that may be true, don't give yourself too much credit too fast.罗睺罗告诫他说:“你现在这感觉可 能是真的，但别这么容易自满。

The effort to continually observe and master the senses is the very foundation of the practice, and not even the most senior disciples can afford to grow lax in their practice."修行最重要的， 是要不停看守着自己的六根，作它们的主人。就 是佛陀的大弟子们，也从来不敢在这方面的修行 上有半点松懈。”
When Vangisa first joined the sangha, he studied under the guidance of Bhikkhu Nigrodhakappa in Aggalava, just outside Savatthi.最初加入僧团的时 候，懵祗沙是在舍卫城外依止尼拘律树伽毗比丘 的。
One day while out begging with Ananda, Vangisa confided that his mind was troubled, and he asked for Ananda's assistance.一天，他与阿难陀在外面乞食时，懵祗沙告诉阿难陀他心中很是困恼，并希望阿难陀可以给 他辅助。
Ananda understood that as an artist, Vangisa was easily touched by beauty.阿难陀很明白，像懵祗沙这 样的一个文人雅士，是会很容易为美色动遥的
He attained the fruit of Never-Returner, confirmed by Venerable Sariputta.舍利弗专者也证明懵 祗已证得‘不还’的果位。

column2: one's heart and mind were opened
column3: The day his heart and mind were opened, Vangisa composed a poem to express his gratitude to the Buddha.他开悟那天，作了一 首诗以表达对佛陀的感激
Vangisa was sometimes troubled by certain afflictions and states of mind.他告诉学僧们，在懵 祗沙修行的初期，他遇到很多心境上的困扰。
but thanks to determined practice, he overcame such states and attained great understanding.幸 而他对修行的坚定，使他把这些境界降伏，证得 真慧。
Learning to master the six senses is a most wonderful method to make firm progress along the path.学会怎样把持六根，就是在大道上进 展的至妙之法。
Rahula's advice was well worth heeding - he should not rest on any laurels.罗睺罗的忠告实在是值得听从的，他真的不可以 太自满。
The Buddha told the younger bhikkhus a story to remind them to observe and master their six senses and not allow themselves to be lost in forgetfulness.佛 陀给一些比较年轻的比丘说了个故事，提醒他们 要把持六根，以免迷失于昏沉惘乱之中。
A person who could not be helped by the Buddha was truly a person without a future.一个佛陀也帮不来 的人，便当真是没有希望的了。
Being refused the chance to practice the Dharma in community is to lose an opportunity that only arises once in a thousand lifetimes.不会再接纳他 为弟子。这将会是极大的不幸。在僧团修行正法 的机会是千载难逢的。
Warrior Rohitassa's face also radiated happiness.庐酰特沙的脸上也泛着无限的 喜悦。
It was like a piece of epic music.它简直就像一娓动人心弦 的乐章。

column2: the first turning of the wheel of Dharma
column3: Since the first turning of the wheel of Dharma, the Dharma had been carried throughout all the countries in the Ganga basin.自佛陀初转法轮以来，正法已被弘传到整个恒河 流域的国家。
Please, Lord, take heed.世尊，请你小 心为要啊。
The Buddha spoke about the Five Powers necessary to nourish the fruits of enlightenment.佛陀说教证果必需的‘五 力’。
The most important thing is your own practice of the noble and pure life of a monk.最重要的，是你们要好好的修行，作一个清净高 洁的僧人。
Jivaka also informed the Buddha of secret political stirrings in the captital in which Devadatta was playing a key role.戌博迦又告诉佛陀， 在城中正在进行的秘密政治活动，提婆达多也是 活跃的份子之一。
Causing the community to break is the most serious violation of the teaching.导致僧团分裂，是严重的违 犯教义’。
Many of the laity gossiped about the schism and blamed it on jealousy and petty feelings.外间流传着很多关于僧团的分裂的闲言。大 多数都是认为归咎于嫉妒和器量少。
Your compassion has no equal, your Majesty!陛下，你的慈悲真是 无量!
佛法讲诸行无常。The Dharma teaches us that all conditioned phenomena are impermanent.

念死无常不是要人悲观绝望，而是要产生一种紧迫感，让我们更加珍惜生命，精进修行。The mindfulness of death and impermanence is not being pessimistic or desperate;instead, it cultivates a sense of urgency that promotes us to cherish our lives more and practice diligently.

column2: renounce the secular life/the renunciation of a secular life
column3: 出家不是把家人当作普通人，而是为把普通人都当作家人。Renouncing the secular life is not to regard family members as non-related strangers, but to treat every non-related strangers as our own families.出家是为了究竟的报恩，出家人的情是对世俗情感的升华和扩大，绝非无情无义。The renunciation of a secular life is to repay their kindness in an ultimate way. Monks and nuns are by no means heartless; on the contrary, they let go of worldly affection in favour of universal compassion.
如果没有父母的养育之恩，也就没有我们今天的一切。Given the incomparable kindness we own to our parents. Otherwise we will be in no position to serve society.

If you think all food comes to you naturally, you may believe that everything is produced without causes.Such thinking will lead to the conclution of no cause and effect, and no karmic retribution.

column3: 我们不能摄心的时候，就没有法，没有用法。没有用法就是内心当中没有法，所以心才会乱，才会妄想多、烦恼多。When our mind are not engaged, there is no Dharma to resort too. We don't have the Dharma to resort to because the Dharma is not within us, therefore, our minds are chaotic and stricken with delutions and afflictions.

column3: 释迦牟尼佛修行成佛后，已经完全了知、通达真相，亲自证悟到诸法的本来面目，也就是胜义谛——涅盘，成佛的境界。这些成佛的境界是可以达到的，是可以用语言文字、逻辑去说明的，也是能够为所有的人所验证的。Through cultivation, Prince Siddhartha Gautama attained Buddhahood and bacame Shakyamuni Buddha who possessed the sublime knowledge and complete truth of the universe. He was enlightened with the meaning of the "impenetrable Ultimate Truth", or Nirvana, a state of Buddhahood. This proves that the state of Buddhahood can be achieved, explained by words and logics, and verified by all of us.

column3: 我们学的教法是佛陀的语言，佛陀的语言表达的是佛的境界，佛的境界是至善圆满、清净圆满的境界。圆满代表一切，圆满是没有欠缺，圆满是没有偏颇。We should know that we are studying the language of Buddha, which reflects the realms of the Buddha that exemplifies perfect kindness and perfect peace. Perfection is all-encompassing, i.e., no incompleteness or bias.

column2: Joy is greatly outweighed by suffering.
column3: 世俗社会里有很多的痛苦，当然也有少量的快乐，归根结底苦多乐少。我们学佛法就要慢慢去解决这个问题，让快乐越来越多，痛苦越来越少。世间法没有办法解决这个问题，只会让痛苦增加，快乐减少；佛法会让快乐增加，痛苦减少，最后没有痛苦。The secular world is full of suffering. Of course, there is some joy, but joy is greatly overweighed by suffering. The purpose of our Dharma study is to address this fundamental problem gradually and eventually increase joy while letting suffering dissipate. There is no solution in the secular world for suffing, which only tends to accumulate while joy fades away. The Dharma, on the other hand, creates just the opposite situation-increasing joy and reducing suffering until suffering is completely vanquished.
column7: 20180331释迦牟尼佛涅盘日 Shakyamuni Buddha's Nirvana Day

column3: 佛教的正见，即正确的认识，以智慧为表现特征。修行的首要问题就是正见，正确的认识如同眼目一样重要。如果一个人没有眼睛，在黑暗中乱摸乱撞是很危险的。The right view in Buddhism, or right way of perception, is characterized by wisdom. It is the foremost thing in cultivation that compared to our eyes. Imagine how dangerous it is for a blind people to venture around.
column7: 20180401智慧从定中来（一） From Concentration Wisdom Arises(Part 1)

column3: 说到打坐，首先还是离不开放下。我们在开始学习打坐时，很想收敛住我们散乱的心。可是越想收敛，却越收敛不住。这是为什么呢？原因就是有对立。因为你想静下来的念头越强烈，其实你离静也就越远了。所以，打坐时首先要放下的就是“想静下来”的这个念头。Speaking of sitting meditation, its number one task is to release. As a beginner, you may feel eager to pull your distracted mind back, but it turns out that the harder you try, the wilder it becomes. Why is this so? Because once you try, you are putting yourself into opposite position; the strong thought that you want to calm down actually pushes you away from calmness. Therefore, the first thing to put down in sitting meditation is the thought of calming down.
column7: 20180401智慧从定中来（一） From Concentration Wisdom Arises(Part 1)

column3: 头脑总是在不断地分辨和思维，它分辨和思维的内容，都是我们从小到大所接触的社会知识。也就是说，我们的头脑时时刻刻都在用这些社会知识来思考问题。而这些社会知识很有局限性，有的甚至极为错误。所以，打坐时要放下我们头脑中的分辨和思维。The brain never stop differentiating and judging, based on the social knowledge we have been taking in since childhood. Our brain works by using this kind of social knowledge, which is often quite limited and sometimes fallacious. In sitting meditation, we have to release the differentiation and judgment of our brain.
column7: 20180401智慧从定中来（一） From Concentration Wisdom Arises(Part 1)

column3: 打坐只是修禅定的一种方式，真正的禅定是在现实生活中，时时刻刻都能以一种智慧的觉照，很自如地把握自心。一个真正有禅定功夫的人，无论走到哪里，无论在干什么，都不会为那些五光十色、纷纷扰扰的事物所动心，他的心始终是清净的、清凉的，没有任何迷惑，不起任何烦恼。The real meditative concentration is a state of being able to observe and tame our mind freely in a wise way in our daily life. The minds of those with true meditative capability will not be distrurbed by external objects whatever they do in any environment. Their minds are always clean and clear without any confusion or affliction.
column7: 20180402智慧从定中来（二） From Concentration Wisdom Arises(Part 2)

column3: 佛陀是无上大医王，太慈悲了，开显出这样的法门，对末世多灾多难的众生来说，真是无比的恩德啊。Known as the Great King of Doctors, the Buddha is so compassionate as to teach this Dharma door. What an incomparable kindness to the troubled beings of the Dharma-ending age.
column7: 20180404恭迎观世音菩萨圣诞 Commemoration of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva's Birthday

column3: 经上说，遇到灾难时，只要一心称名，观世音菩萨就能寻声救苦，若有持观世音菩萨名者，能免七难，能离三毒，能应二求。菩萨以无等的大悲愿力，普遍的平等心，以大悲之智观照一切苦恼的众生，施与救度。所以真心诚意地相信观世音菩萨，菩萨决定会管我们的事，不会不理睬的。The Sutra says if people in disasters chant Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva's name wholeheartedly, he shall save them from suffering upon hearing their voice; those who recite and retain his name will be saved from seven kinds of disasters and three kinds of poisons, and their two kinds of wishes will be fulfilled. Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva, with his unequalled, great compassionate vows and universal impartial mind, uses the wisdom of great compassion to observe and save all the distressed beings. Therefore, if we sincerely believe in him, he shall definitely respond to us.
column7: 20180404恭迎观世音菩萨圣诞 Commemoration of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva's Birthday

column3: 在生活中，处处可以去实践和修持。比如不杀生、吃素、放生，善待生命，善待我们身边的每一个人；别人对我们抱怨、嗔恨、误解时，我们尽量地去包容，而不是以牙还牙。从境界中去学习、成长，并启发我们内在的慈悲和智慧，唤醒我们本具的真如佛性，这才是我们修持所在。Also, we can practice the Dharma everywhere in our daily life. For example, we can refrain the killing, take vegetarian diet, free captive animals, and be kind to all lives and to everyone around us; we can tolerate other's complaints, hatred or misunderstanding insteadof answering blows with blows. We should learn from all situations and grow, and inspire our inner compassion and wisdom to awaken our ture Buddha nature. This is where our practice lies.
column7: 20180404恭迎观世音菩萨圣诞 Commemoration of Avalokitesvara Bodhisattva's Birthday

column3: 普贤菩萨是众多菩萨圣者中的一位，无始劫来启发众生，无有疲累，是大乘菩萨行的大愿大行的代表，象征着大乘佛教的精神。Samantabhadra Bodhisattva is one of these sage bodhisattvas, tirelessly enlightening living beings since beginningless kalpas. Representing the great practices and vows of the bodhisattva practice, he symbolises the spirit of Mahayana Buddhism.
column7: 20180406恭迎普贤菩萨圣诞 Birthday of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva

column2: Three Sages of the flower Adornment Assembly
column3: 普贤菩萨也是“华严三圣”之一，“三圣”即指毗卢遮那佛、文殊菩萨、普贤菩萨。其中，文殊菩萨代表智慧，普贤菩萨代表行愿。这也就是说，如果我们要想证悟殊胜的华严境界——成佛，就必须学习文殊菩萨、普贤菩萨，从智慧、行愿二途趣入，方才究竟。 Samantabhadra Bodhisattva, together with Vairochana Buddha and Manjushri Bodhisattva, are known as the "Three Sages of the Flower Adornment Assembly". Among them, Manjushri Bodhisattva represents wisdom and Samantabhadra Bodhisattva practices and vows. As such, if we are to realise the supreme realm of Flower Adornment, i.e., to achieve Buddhahood, we must learn from Manjushri Bodhisattva and Samantabhadra Bodhisattva by following the path of wisdom and the path of practices and vows. This is the ultimate way.
column7: 20180406恭迎普贤菩萨圣诞 Birthday of Samantabhadra Bodhisattva

column2: whose wise intentions are for others’ good
column3: For, destitute of merit, I am very poor;I have no other wealth. And so, protectors,You whose wise intentions are for others’ good,In your great power, receive them for my sake.福薄我贫穷，无余堪供财，祈求慈怙主，利我受此供！
Enlightened ones and all your Bodhisattva heirs,I offer you my body throughout all my lives.Supreme courageous ones accept me totally.For with devotion I will be your slave.愿以吾身心，恒献佛佛子！恳请哀纳受，我愿为尊仆！

May forests where the leaves are blades and swordsBecome sweet groves and pleasant woodland glades.And may the trees of miracles appear,Supplanting those upon the hill of Shālmali.愿彼剑叶林，悉成美乐园！铁刺树枝干，咸长如意枝！

于一切时，念念自净其心，自修自行，见自己法身，见自心佛。自度自戒，始得。 At all times, in every thought, purify your own mind, cultivate your own conduct, see your own Dharma-body and the Buddha of your own mind. Take yourself across; discipline yourself. Only then will your coming here have not been in vain.
一、戒香。即自心中，无非，无恶，无嫉妒，无贪瞋，无劫害，名戒香。The first is the morality-refuge, which is simply your own mind when free from error, evil, jealousy, greed, hatred and hostility.
二、定香，即睹诸善恶境相，自心不乱，名定香。The second is the concentration-refuge, which is just your own mind which does not become confused when seeing the marks of all good and evil conditions.

三、慧香。自心无碍，常以智慧观照自性，不造诸恶。虽修众善，心不执着，敬上念下，矜恤孤贫，名慧香。The third is the wisdom-refuge, which is simply your own mind when it is unobstructed and when it constantly uses wisdom to contemplate and illuminate the self-nature, when it does no evil, does good without becoming attached, and is respectful of superiors, considerate of inferiors, and sympathetic towards orphans and widows.
四、解脱香，即自心无所攀缘，不思善，不思恶，自在无碍，名解脱香。The fourth is the liberation-refuge, which is simply your own mind independent of conditions, not thinking of good or evil, and free and unobstructed.

column2: the refuge of knowledge and views
column3: 五、解脱知见香。自心既无所攀缘善恶，不可耽空守寂。则须广学多闻，识自本心，达诸佛理。和光接物，无我无人，直至菩提，真性不易。名解脱知见香。The fifth is the refuge of knowledge and views. Which is simply your own mind when it is independent of good and evil conditions and when it does not dwell in emptiness or cling to stillness.
